svg.text: 1. Find the critical constants Tc and Pc of the gas.
2. Reduced values: P_r = P / P_c and T_r = T / T_c.
3. Read Z from the chart at that (P_r , T_r).
4. Then V = Z R T / P — the ideal-gas law corrected by one number.
Z < 1 attraction dominates, Z > 1 repulsion dominates
Original teaching schematic · every gas approaches Z = 1 as P → 0
